name: feed-post
summary: One post in a community feed: the author with avatar, time and a Follow button, an optional title and text, up to four pictures with a small tool label, and a footer of like, dislike and comment counts that double as actions, plus share, views and a more menu.
useWhen: A community page lists what people have shared, newest or most popular first.
Someone's profile shows their posts with the same reactions as the main feed.

alternatives.name: media-grid
alternatives.when: the feed is about the pictures alone, with no text or discussion

alternatives.name: card
alternatives.when: the content is not a person's post, such as an announcement

rules.do: Show reactions and comments as small icon-and-number toggles in one quiet row.
rules.dont: Add big labelled Like, Comment and Share buttons under every post.

rules.do: Keep Follow a small glass button in the author row.
rules.dont: Make Follow a white or lime filled button that competes with the media.

rules.do: Pass counts that already include the viewer's reaction, with `defaultReaction` set to match.
rules.dont: Pass counts without the viewer's reaction, so the number jumps by one on load.

a11y: The post is an `article` named "Post by <author>"; an optional title is an `h3`.
Like and Dislike are toggle buttons with names such as "Like, 88" and announce their pressed state; the pressed like is lime as well, so color is not the only signal.
Follow names the author for screen readers ("Follow Mira Okafor") and changes its label to Following.
The more menu trigger is labelled "More actions for the post by <author>".
